description: This file contains a C# interface for a consistency test grain in Orleans, along with a custom exception class 'UserAbort'. It defines the contract for a grain that performs consistency testing, including a method 'Run' and related supporting classes.

classes.name: UserAbort
classes.description: A custom serializable exception class indicating a user-initiated abort of a transaction.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Initiates a consistency test with specified options, depth, stack trace, max retries, and stop time, returning an array of observations.
